p9/esc539:10.speaker: supporter
p9/esc539:10.text: I'm sorry, I'm sure that has made you feel rejected.

p9/esc539:12.speaker: supporter
p9/esc539:12.text: I'm sure it is hard to express how you feel with it being a short relationship, people may not understand. But sometimes we can feel such a strong connection and have faith in people very fast.

p9/esc539:14.speaker: seeker
p9/esc539:14.text: i loved the girl with all my heart

p9/esc539:15.speaker: supporter
p9/esc539:15.text: I understand feeling connected to someone you've only known for a short amount of time. I'm sure you feel like you wont be able to let your guard down again anytime soon.

p9/esc539:16.speaker: seeker
p9/esc539:16.text: yes i have faith in people very fast

p9/esc539:17.speaker: seeker
p9/esc539:17.text: seriously its like your seeing my mind

p9/esc539:18.speaker: supporter
p9/esc539:18.text: Maybe this could be a learning experience? I always try to see the best in people, but have learned to let people earn my trust. Not just get it for free.

p9/esc539:3.speaker: supporter
p9/esc539:3.text: I'm doing well. How can I help you today?

p9/esc539:4.speaker: seeker
p9/esc539:4.text: a break up with my partner please read up

p9/esc539:5.speaker: supporter
p9/esc539:5.text: I'm so sorry. I went through a bad break up last year. Can you tell me what happened?

p9/esc539:8.speaker: seeker
p9/esc539:8.text: i and this lady dated for 2weeks

p9/esc539:9.speaker: seeker
p9/esc539:9.text: suddenly she said she doesn't love me anymore imagine that

p9/esc682:0.speaker: seeker
p9/esc682:0.text: I just lost my job and am worried about paying the bills.

p9/esc682:1.speaker: supporter
p9/esc682:1.text: I'm sorry to hear you lost your job and have worries about paying the bills.

p9/esc682:11.speaker: supporter
p9/esc682:11.text: Also, job counselors may help at employment agencies to match you with potential employers. Have you tried any?

p9/esc682:12.speaker: seeker
p9/esc682:12.text: I haven't but that may be helpful as well.

p9/esc682:13.speaker: supporter
p9/esc682:13.text: I sought out help from a recruiter online who helped me to find a job as well.  Have you heard of that option or tried it?

p9/esc682:14.speaker: seeker
p9/esc682:14.text: That might help me to take the stress off myself and get someone to help in the search.

p9/esc682:15.speaker: supporter
p9/esc682:15.text: Yes, I see that you seemed to be more relieved finding out these options. Would you say these suggestions have been helpful?

p9/esc682:16.speaker: seeker
p9/esc682:16.text: Yes, I'm starting to feel some of the pressure taken off me.

p9/esc682:17.speaker: supporter
p9/esc682:17.text: From what I've seen, people who can use some of these strategies like deep breathing and counseling they have felt some relief and could move forward better toward their goals.

p9/esc682:18.speaker: seeker
p9/esc682:18.text: I feel a lot better.  Thanks for your support.

p9/esc682:19.speaker: supporter
p9/esc682:19.text: You are welcome.  Can I help you with anything else?

p9/esc682:2.speaker: seeker
p9/esc682:2.text: There is just too much pressure, but I have to succeed.

p9/esc682:20.speaker: seeker
p9/esc682:20.text: I think that will be all.  Thanks again.

p9/esc682:3.speaker: supporter
p9/esc682:3.text: That is hard having so much pressure but I think you will be able to soon get employed again.

p9/esc682:4.speaker: seeker
p9/esc682:4.text: I am trying.  I've started looking online for new positions but it is a process.

p9/esc682:5.speaker: supporter
p9/esc682:5.text: It sounds like you are trying really hard and that is worthy of praise.

p9/esc682:6.speaker: seeker
p9/esc682:6.text: I just still am continually nervous and having a hard time coping.

p9/esc682:7.speaker: supporter
p9/esc682:7.text: Sometimes deep breaths help people calm down.  Have you tried that at all?

p9/esc682:8.speaker: seeker
p9/esc682:8.text: I haven't but maybe that will help me stay calmer.

p9/esc682:9.speaker: supporter
p9/esc682:9.text: That can sometimes help you to regain your focus and be able to do more for yourself.

p9/esc82:10.speaker: supporter
p9/esc82:10.text: I am really sorry that has got to be the worst feeling putting your dog to sleep

p9/esc82:11.speaker: seeker
p9/esc82:11.text: It is. At least I was able to be with her so she wasn't afraid.

p9/esc82:12.speaker: supporter
p9/esc82:12.text: I just think of it this way your dog is in dog heaven and is watching over you that is how i think of it even though it really aint true thats just how i think

p9/esc82:13.speaker: supporter
p9/esc82:13.text: My dog died of old age

p9/esc82:14.speaker: supporter
p9/esc82:14.text: it took me like 2 or 3 weeks to get over it and not cry for once

p9/esc82:15.speaker: seeker
p9/esc82:15.text: I just miss her. I believe she is with her brother. He died 7 years ago. He was hit by a car.

p9/esc82:17.speaker: supporter
p9/esc82:17.text: I can understand how you feeling but everything will be okay and it is ok to miss her

p9/esc82:18.speaker: seeker
p9/esc82:18.text: I was doing pretty good then there was this dog in the movie and I just broke down again.

p9/esc82:19.speaker: supporter
p9/esc82:19.text: I understand I would break down to if I saw that

p9/esc82:2.speaker: supporter
p9/esc82:2.text: How may i help you today?

p9/esc82:20.speaker: supporter
p9/esc82:20.text: Just do something you like to do to get your mind off of it

p9/esc82:21.speaker: seeker
p9/esc82:21.text: It helps to have a person to talk to. I used this chat Hit before right after I had to put her to sleep. The person I talked to then had a dog too.

p9/esc82:22.speaker: supporter
p9/esc82:22.text: Right it is always good to have someone to talk to in a situation like that

p9/esc82:23.speaker: seeker
p9/esc82:23.text: It's a good Idea to do something to get my mind off of it.

p9/esc82:24.speaker: supporter
p9/esc82:24.text: Just by expressing your feelings with someone will help a lot to

p9/esc82:26.speaker: supporter
p9/esc82:26.text: Maybe you can watch a comedy movie or another kind of movie to get your mind off of it

p9/esc82:27.speaker: seeker
p9/esc82:27.text: That sounds like a good idea. A comedy probably would help

p9/esc82:28.speaker: supporter
p9/esc82:28.text: yes it would help. Keep your head up and know your dog is dog heaven and not suffering anymore.

p9/esc82:3.speaker: seeker
p9/esc82:3.text: I've been sad. My dog died

p9/esc82:4.speaker: supporter
p9/esc82:4.text: I am sorry I know exactly how you are feeling I have had a dog that i loved more than anything die couple years ago

p9/esc82:5.speaker: seeker
p9/esc82:5.text: Sorry to hear that. I just watched a movie that had a dog that looked like mine in it. It upset me

p9/esc82:7.speaker: seeker
p9/esc82:7.text: I don't remember the name of the movie, but it was about some kids trying to find homes for dogs that a shelter was closing before Christmas

p9/esc82:8.speaker: supporter
p9/esc82:8.text: Oh ok how did your dog die was something wrong with him or just old age?

p9/esc82:9.speaker: seeker
p9/esc82:9.text: She was old, blind and was getting dog dementia. I had to have her put to sleep

p9/esc88:1.speaker: seeker
p9/esc88:1.text: Not great. I'm feeling pretty down in the dumps.

p9/esc88:10.speaker: seeker
p9/esc88:10.text: Fair enough. What do you suggest I try?

p9/esc88:11.speaker: supporter
p9/esc88:11.text: I am going to ask you a few questions if OK i don't want to sound like i am prying.

p9/esc88:12.speaker: seeker
p9/esc88:12.text: That's fine. I'm open to discussion.

p9/esc88:13.speaker: supporter
p9/esc88:13.text: OK do yo live in a rural or city, are you into male females or the like?

p9/esc88:14.speaker: seeker
p9/esc88:14.text: I'm in a rural area, and I'm interested in women.

p9/esc88:15.speaker: supporter
p9/esc88:15.text: I too live in a rural area understand the complexities of tying to find someone. So my next question where looking to find that special connection.

p9/esc88:16.speaker: seeker
p9/esc88:16.text: I've had to resort to online dating and such as there are few opportunities to meet people in person.

p9/esc88:17.speaker: supporter
p9/esc88:17.text: I understand doing that I have tried it myself and trying to find that connection is few and far between. What sites have you tried using?

p9/esc88:18.speaker: seeker
p9/esc88:18.text: Basically all of the ones you would expect. How would you suggest meeting people in person?

p9/esc88:19.speaker: supporter
p9/esc88:19.text: Well It would depend on if you were religious I  would suggest church functions for example. I use my hobbies like pool and darts and cards and join groups that creates some common ground.

p9/esc88:2.speaker: supporter
p9/esc88:2.text: Im sorry to hear that. how can I help

p9/esc88:20.speaker: seeker
p9/esc88:20.text: That sounds like a good idea. Do you attend meetups?

p9/esc88:21.speaker: supporter
p9/esc88:21.text: I have and i usually take someone i  trust with me and if it doesnt feel right I leave.

p9/esc88:22.speaker: seeker
p9/esc88:22.text: That's good advice. Thanks for your help.

p9/esc88:23.speaker: supporter
p9/esc88:23.text: No problem glad I could help.

p9/esc88:24.speaker: supporter
p9/esc88:24.text: Is there anything else I can help with?

p9/esc88:3.speaker: seeker
p9/esc88:3.text: I'm not sure how, exactly. I'm dealing with repeated rejections.

p9/esc88:4.speaker: supporter
p9/esc88:4.text: That is always tough especially during this time of year and been there myself.

p9/esc88:5.speaker: supporter
p9/esc88:5.text: What type of rejection  are you experiencing

p9/esc88:6.speaker: seeker
p9/esc88:6.text: Romantic rejection. It seems like every time I make an effort, it's immediately shot down.

p9/esc88:7.speaker: supporter
p9/esc88:7.text: I hate to ask you this but are you male or female?

p9/esc88:9.speaker: supporter
p9/esc88:9.text: I ask it changes the perception on how I may help you because male and females deal with things differently.

p9/esc994:0.speaker: supporter
p9/esc994:0.text: Hi, I'm here to listen. What's going on?

p9/esc994:1.speaker: seeker
p9/esc994:1.text: Thank you. I've lost my job and I'm very nervous about the future

p9/esc994:10.speaker: seeker
p9/esc994:10.text: I am a gig worker, so I cannot apply for IU. Its very hard, but i also have some savings.

p9/esc994:11.speaker: seeker
p9/esc994:11.text: What kind of tools would you recommend I use to get through this

p9/esc994:12.speaker: supporter
p9/esc994:12.text: Well, falling back on savings while you look for more work is good for a while. If you have any food insecurity as a result, there are often local food banks. It's really not something to be embarrased about, so many people face food insecurity through no fault of their own.

p9/esc994:13.speaker: supporter
p9/esc994:13.text: You could also give a call to your local social services because they will be able to tell you what resources would be available, whether it's a vocational program or temporary assistance.

p9/esc994:14.speaker: seeker
p9/esc994:14.text: Wow you're so helpful and encouraging! It's very nice to talk to you.

p9/esc994:15.speaker: seeker
p9/esc994:15.text: Are there any meds you can recommend to help me sleep?

p9/esc994:16.speaker: supporter
p9/esc994:16.text: Well, if it's possible, I would talk to a doctor. If you're looking for Over-the-counter sleep medication, melatonin has helped me in the past.

p9/esc994:17.speaker: seeker
p9/esc994:17.text: Wow! I've never used melatonin before. Did it really help you? Are you doing much better now?

p9/esc994:18.speaker: supporter
p9/esc994:18.text: It defiitely helps me fall asleep.

p9/esc994:2.speaker: seeker
p9/esc994:2.text: As a result I am having a hard time sleeping

p9/esc994:20.speaker: supporter
p9/esc994:20.text: If something like that doesn't work, I would talk to a doctor. I know money will be tight though. Are there any free clinics near you?

p9/esc994:21.speaker: seeker
p9/esc994:21.text: I'll look into it. There's a lot of services in the general area that might be able to help me

p9/esc994:22.speaker: seeker
p9/esc994:22.text: It's been really nice talking to you

p9/esc994:23.speaker: supporter
p9/esc994:23.text: Thank you. I hope you're feeling a bit better. Is there anything else you want to talk about?

p9/esc994:24.speaker: seeker
p9/esc994:24.text: No I'm okay. I think that's everything :)

p9/esc994:25.speaker: supporter
p9/esc994:25.text: Alright, well I hope you have a good night. Good luck, you've got this!

p9/esc994:3.speaker: supporter
p9/esc994:3.text: Wow, that's very hard. I would be anxious too.

p9/esc994:4.speaker: seeker
p9/esc994:4.text: That makes me feel a lot better. Have you ever lost your job?

p9/esc994:5.speaker: supporter
p9/esc994:5.text: I have. I was laid off. It was nerve-racking, but also really sad.

p9/esc994:6.speaker: seeker
p9/esc994:6.text: What helped you get through it?

p9/esc994:7.speaker: supporter
p9/esc994:7.text: I had a bit in savings, but I looked for new jobs mostly. I was on unemployment insurance for about a month before I found a new job.

p9/esc994:8.speaker: supporter
p9/esc994:8.text: Have you made any plans yet about how to move forward?

p9/esc994:9.speaker: supporter
p9/esc994:9.text: I can offer some suggestions if you would like. I know about a lot of resources

p9/p9_conv_1:0.speaker: supporter
p9/p9_conv_1:0.text: Hey Michael, how’s everything going with you today?

p9/p9_conv_1:1.speaker: seeker
p9/p9_conv_1:1.text: Hey, to be honest, I've been better. Feeling a bit stuck right now.

p9/p9_conv_1:10.speaker: supporter
p9/p9_conv_1:10.text: Your concerns are completely valid. Financial stability and having support around is really important. Have you considered any alternatives?

p9/p9_conv_1:11.speaker: seeker
p9/p9_conv_1:11.text: I've been looking for more opportunities around here, but they are few and far between. It’s making me feel pretty trapped.

p9/p9_conv_1:12.speaker: supporter
p9/p9_conv_1:12.text: It must be frustrating to feel like your options are limited. How do you usually handle situations like this?

p9/p9_conv_1:13.speaker: seeker
p9/p9_conv_1:13.text: I usually just try to work through it, hoping something better comes up. But it’s hard to stay positive right now.

p9/p9_conv_1:2.speaker: supporter
p9/p9_conv_1:2.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Do you want to talk about what's been on your mind?

p9/p9_conv_1:3.speaker: seeker
p9/p9_conv_1:3.text: I got a job offer. Normally, that would be good news, but it's not as great as it sounds.

p9/p9_conv_1:4.speaker: supporter
p9/p9_conv_1:4.text: Oh really? What's got you feeling hesitant about it?

p9/p9_conv_1:5.speaker: seeker
p9/p9_conv_1:5.text: Well, it’s far from where I live, in a completely different area, and the pay is pretty low.

p9/p9_conv_1:6.speaker: supporter
p9/p9_conv_1:6.text: That sounds really challenging. Moving and taking a pay cut are big decisions. What are your main concerns?

p9/p9_conv_1:7.speaker: seeker
p9/p9_conv_1:7.text: Mainly, it's about leaving behind what little network I have here and starting over somewhere else for something that doesn’t seem worth it.

p9/p9_conv_1:8.speaker: supporter
p9/p9_conv_1:8.text: Leaving familiar places and people can be really tough. It makes sense that you'd feel conflicted.

p9/p9_conv_1:9.speaker: seeker
p9/p9_conv_1:9.text: Exactly. I keep thinking, is it worth uprooting everything just for the sake of a job that might not even cover my basic expenses?

spans.speaker: seeker
spans.exact_quote: yes i have faith in people very fast

spans.speaker: seeker
spans.exact_quote: I am a gig worker, so I cannot apply for IU. Its very hard, but i also have some savings.

spans.speaker: seeker
spans.exact_quote: I'm in a rural area, and I'm interested in women.

spans.speaker: seeker
